// Fixture guarding against false positives: the legitimate BFF shape — standard library, gRPC as
// a transport, and this repo's own generated contracts. No violations expected.
package handler

import (
	"context"

	"google.golang.org/grpc"

	agentv1 "github.com/gitfrok/bff/gen/proto/agent/v1"
)

func Health(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) agentv1.HealthState {
	_ = ctx
	_ = conn
	return agentv1.HealthState_HEALTHY
}
